caption: The drawing depicts a decorative arrangement of stylized flowers in a vase set against a brown, quilted-pattern background. The vase is predominantly dark blue with diamond-shaped accents and is outlined with cream, and it features ornamental handles adorned with a blue circular element and a star-like form with a black border. Five long stems with a green and beige pattern emerge from the vase, each supporting a different flower at the end. From left to right, the first and fifth flowers have concentric layered petals in red, pink, cream, and blue tones. The second and fourth flowers are made up of red and gray circular shapes arranged in a triangle, surrounded by green textured borders. The central flower at the top has a blue, fuzzy star-shaped outline with clusters of purple and white circles inside. The overall composition is symmetrical, with the flowers evenly distributed and the vase centered in the lower part of the image. The artist's name "Ruth M. Barnes" is inscribed in the lower right and the code "L1763-A" in the lower left.
title: Coverlet (Applique) Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
